comments.text: Please don’t feel there were no struggles for the ‘Boomers’ or ‘GenX’. Times were tough all over. We lived within our means. We worked two jobs, just like some of you. We didn’t see the kids’ ball games, because we worked those extra hours. There were no extras. We couldn’t afford the homes we actually wanted. We had to cut regular milk with powdered milk. We had one pair of shoes. We didn’t go to Target every day. Most of us had a garden for vegetables. We ate wild berries, fished and hunted. Our electric would be turned off if it wasn’t paid on time. The list goes on. At least I would guess, most of you have running water in your homes. Imagine three kids in a little home with frozen water all winter. Or it being so cold in your bedroom that water froze overnight in the glass. We struggled through with much less. Yeah, that was the ‘70s. Minimum wage about $2.30/hr. We learned to save, even a little. There was no wanting, want that boat, or want that new car. We paid our dues. America has always been a struggle. Some are wealthy, and some aren’t.
